performance.statement: not predicted: no performance model is calibrated for this backend yet; the ordering below rests on measured relative speeds, not on a time estimate

reasons: experts4bit: kernel paged_graphs not usable here: the fused FP8 KV append casts to e4m3 in Triton, which needs sm_89+; this device is sm_86
experts4bit: vram_gb sized to 1.582, the largest the device budget allows
experts4bit: dram_gb sized to 1.582, the largest the host budget allows
all experts resident (placement all-vram): 4.10 GiB estimated + 0.53 GiB headroom fits the 10.65 GiB budget
KV pool 0.58 GiB for 4 sequences x 4096 tokens; it scales linearly in both

kernels: paged FP8 KV pool + attention, f32 compute (fp8 compute needs sm_89+, fp8_paged_attn.fp8_compute_unsupported); grouped NF4 / int4 decode routes as serve_paged resolves them (reported at /health)

first-chunk prefill graph off (the server's default is auto): its private pool is not priced (SC2b measured +3.3 GiB at Qwen3-30B), so the plan's memory would not bound the process; fix prefill_graph=auto to let the server engage it when that much is free
int4 levers off: exp_int4 and attn_int4 change the served weights (round-to-nearest int4), so the planner prices them only when fixed
not planned yet: a measured routing profile for the solver, decode speed

to serve it: E4B_PAGED_BUCKETS=1,2,4 E4B_PAGED_CHUNK_TOKENS=512 E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB=6.0 E4B_PAGED_GRAPHS=0 E4B_PAGED_HOT_ROWS=64 E4B_PAGED_KV_GROUPS=auto E4B_PAGED_MAX_SEQS=4 E4B_PAGED_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SEQ=4096 E4B_PAGED_PLACEMENT=all-vram E4B_PAGED_PREFILL_GRAPH=0 E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB=1.2 E4B_SERVE_ATTN_INT4=0 E4B_SERVE_EXP_INT4=0 python -m experts4bit_qlora.serve_paged (with the model's arena and calibration)
